summary: Ford Credit Floorplan LLC, Ford Credit Floorplan Corporation, Ford Credit Floorplan Master Owner Trust A, and Ford Motor Credit Company LLC filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to report the issuance of asset-backed securities (Notes) under a shelf registration. The filing provides legality and tax opinions from counsel Katten Muchin Rosenman LLP for this takedown. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is disclosed. This is a routine structured-finance shelf takedown filing, not a special situation.
